Official material identifies these groups in Riverglades alongside Gnoll camps and Ogre threats. Individual NPC identities and functions remain pending.
Powderfuse Port is identified as Riverglades' port and a destination for the new Steamwheedle Cartel sea route. The port is a location node, not an NPC record.
Official material confirms emerging factions, alliances, and story development following the Battle for Mount Hyjal, but does not yet provide enough individual NPC detail for a reliable roster.

record_schema.name: display name
record_schema.type: quest_giver | trainer | vendor | profession | boss | camp | creature | other

coverage_schema.id: stable research-scope id, not an individual NPC id
coverage_schema.named_groups: optional source-backed faction or organization names

data_rules: NPC records should be added only when a Forever source identifies the NPC or its function.
Do not reuse Classic NPC coordinates or vendor inventories without Forever confirmation.
Coverage records may track named factions, organizations, and locations without pretending they are individual NPCs.
Profession and camping trainers are useful relationship nodes and should connect to profession and recipe entities when documented.
